module_summary: RISC-V load/store unit: decodes load/store/CSR-cache ops, computes address and byte-lane write data into an E1 request register, tracks one outstanding access, and aligns/sign-extends load responses using a request-info FIFO.

anchors.name: opcode_valid_i
anchors.why: Issue valid qualifying address, read and write request generation

anchors.name: opcode_opcode_i
anchors.why: Instruction word decoded into load/store size and cache ops

anchors.name: opcode_ra_operand_i
anchors.why: Base register operand for effective address

anchors.name: opcode_rb_operand_i
anchors.why: Store data operand placed into byte lanes

anchors.name: load_inst_w
anchors.why: Load instruction decode selecting address form and read request

anchors.name: load_signed_inst_w
anchors.why: Signed load decode stored for response sign extension

anchors.name: req_lb_w
anchors.why: Byte access decode; representative of size decodes

anchors.name: req_sw_lw_w
anchors.why: Word access decode for misalignment check

anchors.name: dcache_flush_w
anchors.why: CSR write to DFLUSH decoded into cache flush request

anchors.name: mem_addr_r
anchors.why: Effective address: base plus load/store immediate

anchors.name: mem_unaligned_r
anchors.why: Misalignment detect suppressing read/write request

anchors.name: mem_data_r
anchors.why: Store data shifted into byte lanes

anchors.name: mem_wr_r
anchors.why: Computed byte write enables for store size and offset

anchors.name: mem_addr_o
anchors.why: Word-aligned memory request address from mem_addr_q

anchors.name: mem_data_wr_o
anchors.why: Memory write data from request register

anchors.name: mem_rd_o
anchors.why: Memory read request, masked while a response is late

anchors.name: mem_wr_o
anchors.why: Byte write strobes issuing store request, masked on delay

anchors.name: mem_accept_i
anchors.why: Memory accept; issues request and frees request register

anchors.name: mem_ack_i
anchors.why: Memory response; completes access and pops request FIFO

anchors.name: mem_error_i
anchors.why: Bus error response causing squash and fault exception

anchors.name: mem_data_rd_i
anchors.why: Read data aligned and extended for writeback

anchors.name: mem_invalidate_o
anchors.why: Cache invalidate request from CSR op

anchors.name: mem_writeback_o
anchors.why: Cache writeback request from CSR op

anchors.name: mem_flush_o
anchors.why: Cache flush request from CSR op

anchors.name: mem_cacheable_o
anchors.why: Cacheable attribute from address range compare

anchors.name: pending_lsu_e2_q
anchors.why: Outstanding access flag set on issue, cleared on ack

anchors.name: delay_lsu_e2_w
anchors.why: Late response stall holding request register and masking requests

anchors.name: issue_lsu_e1_w
anchors.why: Request accepted; sets pending flag

anchors.name: complete_err_e2_w
anchors.why: Error completion squashing next request

anchors.name: mem_unaligned_e1_q
anchors.why: Misaligned access in E1; stalls and generates dummy ack

anchors.name: mem_unaligned_e2_q
anchors.why: Dummy ack for misaligned access raising alignment exception

anchors.name: mem_load_q
anchors.why: Load/size/sign request attributes pushed into response FIFO

anchors.name: resp_load_w
anchors.why: Popped request type selecting load result and fault kind

anchors.name: resp_addr_w
anchors.why: Popped request address for lane select and bad address

anchors.name: wb_result_r
anchors.why: Load result lane-selected and sign-extended, or fault address

anchors.name: writeback_valid_o
anchors.why: Writeback valid on memory ack or misaligned dummy ack

anchors.name: writeback_exception_o
anchors.why: Exception code from alignment, page and bus faults

anchors.name: fault_load_align_w
anchors.why: Representative fault-class flag selecting exception code

anchors.name: stall_o
anchors.why: Pipeline stall when memory busy, response late or misaligned

groups.name: Opcode decode
groups.description: Decodes load/store sizes, signedness and CSR cache maintenance ops

groups.name: Address and store data generation
groups.description: Effective address adder, misalignment check, byte-lane store data and strobes

groups.name: E1 request register
groups.description: Registered memory request driving the data memory/cache bus

groups.name: Outstanding access control
groups.description: Tracks pending access, delays issue, squashes on faults, generates stall

groups.name: Load response
groups.description: Request-info FIFO plus load alignment, sign extension and exception encoding
